name: Theme Modal UI
description: Theme selection dialog with base style and dark/light mode picker, preview swatches.

dom.root: .theme-overlay (position: fixed, inset: 0, background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6), display: flex, align-items: center, justify-content: center, z-index: 10000)
children: .theme-modal (background: var(--surface), border: 1px dashed var(--border), border-radius: 8px, padding: 32px, min-width: 400px)
.theme-base-section (label: 'Base Style', radio/button group: default / monokai / idol)

interactions.name: select_base
interactions.action: Highlight selected option, update preview swatch

interactions.name: apply
interactions.action: Resolve promise with {base, mode} → Remove overlay → Apply via theme.setDark() + theme.apply()
interactions.result: Theme applied, promise resolved with selection

interactions.name: cancel
interactions.action: Resolve promise with null → Remove overlay
interactions.result: No theme change, promise resolved null

states.open: Overlay visible, current theme pre-selected, swatch showing preview
states.previewing: Selection changed but not applied — preview swatch shows hypothetical result
